title: Wrong icon shown when launching same app twice via two different .desktop files that have different icons
line: An app started from a second desktop file with its own icon now gets its own task with that icon instead of joining the app's usual task.
explanation: The task manager maps a window to a desktop file from the window's own metadata: its app id first, then its X11 class against StartupWMClass. Two desktop files that start the same program (for example Thunderbird with two profiles, or a second launcher with other arguments and its own icon) give windows with identical metadata, so both always mapped to the program's own desktop file, icon and task. Now, when one of those matches is found and KIO launched the process in its own systemd unit (app-<desktop file>-<uuid>.scope or app-<desktop file>@<uuid>.service), the desktop file named there is preferred, as long as it runs the same executable and doesn't declare a StartupWMClass for some other window.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: use the desktop file a window was launched from

When two desktop files start the same program, its windows share an app
id, so they were always mapped to the program's own desktop file and
icon. Now prefer the desktop file in the process's systemd launch unit.

BUG: 475736
